Density measurement test on all soil at relative density approx 0.15; apparatus: scoop or shovel; loading: placing rather than dropping. Recorded: relative density and bed uniformity after placement.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
